Passive.Name: The Black Silence
Passive.Desc: Has unique EGO pages and BGM. (Untransferable)

Passive.Name: The Returner
Passive.Desc: Starts at Emotional Level 1. “Returner” triggers upon taking fatal damage, restores all HP and Stagger. “Returner” triggers up to the current emotion level. When “Returner” is triggered, max health value is increased by 20, max break value is increased by 10 and become invulnerable to status ailments. (Untransferable)

Passive.Name: The Returner
Passive.Desc: Starts at Emotional Level 2. “Returner” triggers upon taking fatal damage, restores all HP and Stagger. “Returner” triggers up to the current emotion level. When “Returner” is triggered, max health value is increased by 50, max break value is increased by 30 and become invulnerable to status ailments. (Untransferable)

Passive.Name: Shimmering
Passive.Desc: At the start of each Scene, exhaust all pages in hand and deck; add new pages to hand. (Untransferable)

Passive.Name: Perception-blocking Mask
Passive.Desc: A Speed die with the lowest Speed becomes untargetable (untransferable)

Passive.Name: Eternal Silence
Passive.Desc: Every 10 Scenes. Reduce 1 stack of Returner (Untransferable)

Passive.Name: Black Gloves
Passive.Desc: All dice on the page selected in the 3rd Speed dice slot gain +3 Power. (untransferable)

Passive.Name: Relentless Grudge
Passive.Desc: Recover 1-3 Stagger Resist or Recover 1-3 HP on hit (Untransferable)

Passive.Name: Combo
Passive.Desc: All dice on every 5th Combat Page used gain +5 Power. (Untransferable)

Passive.Name: Revenge
Passive.Desc: Gain a Counter Slash dice (4-8; [On Clash Win] All dice on target's page lose 5 Power) at combat start. (Untransferable)

Passive.Name: You Have to Try Harder than That!
Passive.Desc: Choose the Speed dice with the lowest value; the Speed values of the dice change to the maximum possible value. Boost the *maximum* roll value of all dice by +3. (Untransferable)

Passive.Name: Unstable Shackle
Passive.Desc: Take 1-3 extra Stagger Damage or Damage from all sources. Destroy this passive when Returner stacks is equal or above 3 (Untransferable)
